notes.title: 🍔 Welcome to Diner Simulator — Demo Available NOW! 🍔
notes.content:
It’s time to cook, serve, and survive in the world of high-paced diner madness. Whether you’re flying solo or teaming up with friends, the kitchen chaos is real.Expand your café, manage the chaos, and make it a delicious success — or a total disaster. What’s it gonna be?🎮 Play the demo and show us your culinary skills!
